text: rachel_docs: FYI ran the weekly docs-scan and found a batch of orphan fragments across the KB and runtime guides. Not breaking prod, but the `/help` quicklinks in the app return 404 for a few fragments. Asking for a quick sweep this afternoon. edge-bot: docs-scan: 8 orphan fragments detected in /kb and /docs/runtime -> https://scans.internal/1729993210 (auto) rachel_docs: sample failures: ``` /kb/ops-runbook.md#node-eviction-policy -> 404 /docs/runtime/perf-tips.md#burst-throttling -> 404 /kb/apikeys.md#rotate-keys -> 404 ``` I suspect these were renamed during the recent tidy. tony_sre: I can own the runbook ones. If you add redirect entries to docs-redirects.yaml I can roll them through the infra pipeline. claire: Ill take the KB pages. Plan: add explicit aliases where feasible and update the redirect list for older links. sam_engineer: Heads-up: the in-app quicklinks are cached in the front-end for 4h. If we want the app fixed immediately, we should either hotpatch the quicklink targets or purge the CDN after merge. rachel_docs: Good point. Let's do this: small dedicated PRs per area so reviewers can fast-approve. We'll add a short changelog entry and a line in the docs contribution guide to avoid removing old anchors without aliases. pr-bot: Recommended checks: docs-anchors, markdown-link-check, preview build. claire: Opening PR `docs/kb-anchor-stability` now with alias anchors + docs-redirects.yaml snippet. Will keep diff tiny. tony_sre: I'll open `docs/runbook-anchor-patches` for the runbook redirects and include sample YAML mapping for infra. pr-bot: PRs created: kb PR https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/9001, runbook PR https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/9002 (queued checks). rachel_docs: @sam_engineer once PRs merge can you coordinate a quick CDN purge for `/kb` and `/docs/runtime` so the app quicklinks resolve instantly? If not, I'll update the quicklinks to canonical anchors as a fallback. sam_engineer: Yep I can purge after CI green. If anything blocks, Ill update the quicklinks as a temporary fix. claire: PR merged, docs-anchors passed. Added a one-liner to CONTRIBUTING.md: "When renaming headers, add alias anchors or update docs-redirects.yaml." tony_sre: Runbook PR merged. Infra applied redirect mapping. Preview and staging show no 404s. edge-bot: post-merge re-scan: no orphan fragments detected. rachel_docs: Great, closing the loop. Filing a quick follow-up ticket to sweep other recently-reorged pages next week. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
